name: TCL 75C755 QD-Mini LED
summary: Turn off TCL tracking, promo rows and retail demo apps on the TCL 75C755 QD-Mini LED. TidyTV is a free phone app with a backup and a one-tap undo.
intro: This 2024 TCL Google TV ships with Samba TV viewing tracking, TCL analytics and a log uploader. It also has TCL Live channels, promo rows, a message box and a movie browser, plus retail demo and hotel mode apps, an e-manual, the Alexa app, a cleaner app, and casting and mirroring services that are off by choice.

This was applied and checked on a real 75-inch unit on 20 October 2026. Wi-Fi, HDMI switching through the Inputs menu, Assistant, and Netflix and Disney+ playback all worked afterwards. TidyTV turns these items off from your phone over Wi-Fi. It saves a backup first, switches each app off without deleting it, and stops if anything looks wrong.
keep: Live TV and HDMI, through TCL's TV app and input service.
The remote's microphone button, through the remote service that carries its voice search.
The Input button panel, which is TCL's source panel.
Firmware updates, delivered through Google Play services.
Wi-Fi setup services, and the sound service that also works with TCL speakers.
notes: The remote's Input button always opens TCL's own source panel, and it cannot be redirected to another menu.
Firmware updates come through Google Play services, so there is no separate TCL updater on this set.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 75C755?
faq.a: Yes. The remote service that carries the microphone button is kept on, and Google Assistant worked in testing.
Chromecast is off by choice in this list, and AirPlay and Miracast are off too. Restore everything turns them back on in one tap.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off the TCL channel app, the promo and message services, and the TCL partner rows on the home screen. Restore everything turns them back on in one tap.
